title: brickellia diffusa
intro: Brickellia diffusa, commonly known as mountain sage, is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Brickellia diffusa include reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which have shown antioxidant and immunomodulatory properties.
